notes.title: Druids, Furfolk, and Relic Defense DLC and FREE Mount Update OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Purchase the new premium DLC and embrace your wild side by playing as the new Druid class! Druids can transform into a variety of forms with unique abilities, including a ferocious bear, a spine chilling spider and...slime. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11811312/6ddd0c50a77ee96830d7c96d77b60ec814e3d61c.jpg[/img]

A furrrrther race joins the world of Elysia too - the Furfolk. Which arrive with customizable fur colors, ears and muzzles. Cute!  ( Don’t tell them we said that though ) 


Relic Defense! Three new action-packed arenas! Defend ancient relics known as the Star Stones by crafting traps and magical bombardments to overcome waves of enemy onslaught. Earn heroic rewards including a mythical unicorn and dragon mounts. Each arena also features a Hard Mode ( only for the bravest of Portal Knights of course  ) 

The Druids, Furfolk, and Relic Defense DLC is currently 10% off - please note you need to have the base game installed! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11811312/163a661edcd43d677d4bc19e59b216edbd6f64e6.jpg[/img]

A FREE content update has also been made available with fun features including:
[list]
[*] Basic mounts now available for all players including horses and pigs! – available at NPC merchants throughout the land of Elysia
[*] Musical pressure plates are now available for in-game purchase in Portal Knights adventure mode. Team up with friends and try and make some beautiful music together. Make sure to show us your creations! 
[*] Creative Mode additions including waypoints set for enemies and new items to help players build their very own race tracks for newly earned mounts.
[*] PC ONLY: Players can edit the text of NPCs and create their own mini-adventures!
[*] Bug fixes and stability improvements throughout Portal Knights
[/list]

notes.title: Stability Update 1.6.3 OUT NOW
notes.content:
Stability Update 1.6.3

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Mannequins and Pet Stations are no longer exempted from permission settings. 
• NPCs that were no longer relocate-able have been fixed.
• Setting the host settings to “Private” no longer disables the session search in the Join menu.
• Added another security check for character saving in multiplayer sessions.
• Fixed a potential crash when mining many blocks and furniture in multiplayer.
• Fixed a rare scenario where Rift Achievements progress was not saved correctly.
• Tweaked the armor values of some end-game armor pieces.
• Controller support has been improved in the DLC store menu.
• Moved an incorrect recipe entry at the Altar crafting station to the Rogue crafting station.
• Several furniture pieces didn’t stack correctly. Other furniture was sold twice by one merchant. Both cases have been fixed.
• Pet sounds have been tweaked to occur less often and be a bit quieter. Also fixed a few minor sound issues.
• Home island protection now works as intended on Wifi/Lan only game sessions.
• Fixed various loca issues.

notes.title: Elves, Rogues, and Rifts Premium DLC & FREE Questing Update Launching Today!
notes.content:
Portal Knights... The Elves, Rogues, and Rifts DLC expansion launches today on Steam, PS4 (EU) and Xbox One. Purchase the new premium DLC and play as the new rogue class, meet a new Elven race on Elysia's moon, Faynore and take on new challenges in the roguelite Rifts!

Free for all players is our all-new Questing Update! Take on new quests from the Mage Guild, track your quests in a new persistent Quest log and create and test new creations in Creative Mode using placeable enemies and logic items!

Coming to PlayStation 4 (NA) June 28th 2019.
Coming to Nintendo Switch Summer 2019. (Date TBC)

[b]Steam Content Update 1.6.0[/b]

[b]Features[/b]
• The Mage’s Guild can now be visited on Glimmerglen (3-04). It’s filled with new quests, NPCs, and rewards. See the barber there for some fresh, new hairstyles!
• Creative Mode has been updated with several much-requested features:
o Islands can be quickly tested on the fly by pausing the game and selecting “Test Play Island”.
o You can now place enemies! Note that they will only come to life when you select “Test Play Island”.
o Lots of “logic” objects have been added to create puzzles and gameplay challenges for other players. These include buttons, pressure plates, traps, interactive doors and lights, a connection tool, and more.
o To help show how the new logic objects work, we’ve created a special Steam Workshop island showcasing various behaviors. You can download the island here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1756113825
• Quests can now be tracked across islands in the new Quest Log! Simply select which quests you want to track.
• You can now set the multiplayer visibility of your game to PUBLIC! Selecting PUBLIC visibility means that non-friend players will be able to join your game.
• To prevent island vandalism, game hosts can set permissions for friends and non-friends on their home, canvas, and creative islands.
• You can find public games to join in the “Find Games” menu.
• In the Find Games menu, each game’s connection quality is now displayed.
• Character creation facial options have been expanded with freckles, wrinkles, and more.
• The Ranger class has a powerful new skill – the “Explosive Shot”. It can be crafted at the Archer Station.
• Beautiful new dresses can be found on dress merchants in Fort Finch (1-03), Hintertown (2-03), and Glimmerglen (3-04).
• Individual players can be muted.
• The tutorial in Squire’s Knoll (1-01) has been enhanced.

[b]Changes[/b]
• Durability has been removed from all weapons and tools. Armor sets with durability-related perks have been given different perks instead.
• Gem dust recipes have been moved to the Workbench tiers (to make it easier for non-Mage players to craft skills).
• The number of character slots has been increased. 
• Split-screen guests now select from the same character pool as the host.
• Text on sign posts can be changed by the player.
• Player chests now have a preview showing the item in their first slot.
• The amount of gold lost when you die is now capped at 100.
• It’s easier to level up through the first few player levels.
• Portal shard drop rate has been increased. Portal shards and stones can now also be obtained from some quests as a reward.
• Light sources can now be switched on and off by the player.
• Added coal to Dusty Junction (1-02) so that class-specific armor and weapons can be crafted sooner. Only affects new or regenerated universes.
• Moved a quest from Callum’s Claim (1-09) to Dusty Junction (1-02). This only affects new or regenerated universes.
• Added “V-sync” to the display settings.
• Lots of improvements to the UI, including an icon to show which texts are editable, better controls in the Creative Mode backpack, and more.
• Improvements to visual effects when mining trees.

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Improved stability for islands with a high number of props (furniture, chests, etc.)
• Fixed crashes that affected some users.
• Fixed rare cases of saving errors that would cause islands to be saved incorrectly.
• Improved multiplayer performance.
• Improved camera movement, especially for the automatic camera.
• Various minor bug fixes.
If you wish to see the newest updates on your islands, create a new universe or regenerate an existing one!

https://youtu.be/n_HHHJ9dLME

notes.title: OUT NOW - The Villainous Update (v 1.5.1)
notes.content:
PLEASE NOTE - Regeneration is required to access some of this new content. Vacant islands and your home island are safe from regeneration.

[b]FEATURES[/b]

- Three new bosses have been added – the Slime Queen, the Knight Hunter, and the All-Watcher! Quests in Port of Caul (1-07), Witchwater (2-12), and Sea of Stalks (3-06) will lead you to three epic battles. (Regeneration required.)
- The Ranger’s Guild “Bodkin’s Point” has been added to Hintertown (2-03) along with new quests, NPCs, merchants and much more to discover! (Regeneration required.)
- A “Smart Camera” option has been added and enabled by default when using a controller. The Smart Camera will automatically track the player and position itself behind them.
- New side-by-side chest menu! When you open a chest or other container, you’ll now see a handy side-by-side view of your backpack and the chest, along with shortcuts for mass item transfers and stacking.
- An unlimited water source item has been added to Creative Mode.
- Kitchen-themed items have been added to Creative Mode.
- Traps are now available for Rangers to use against enemies.
- Consumable items and recipes can now be used directly from your backpack (via the More Actions menu).
- Completed events now grant XP and gold.
- Added rare drop chance for pirate trophy to hollow knight pirates.

[b]CHANGES[/b]

-The quest system has been reworked – regenerating a universe no longer resets quests.
- Added variants of gold coin drop models to signify larger gold drop amounts.
- Remaining event time is now shown in the quest HUD.
- Fast travel by gamepad has now dedicated hotkeys for going home and returning to landing pad.
- Completing quests shows a new quest completion popup.
- Screen resolution list in the graphical options menu is now sorted in a menu instead of a dropdown list to be more robust.
- High value items now have new VFX when dropped.
-Adjusted the duration of flying merchant events to better fit with other event lengths.
- Mr. Pickles cave can now always be found in the same area near the landlubber’s leap pirate town.Before, he was too hard to find occasionally.
- NPC greeting sounds trigger now when the player is closer than before. This should improve greeting spam in densely populated areas.
- Rearranged the title screen buttons. The offline play option has been removed as the player can set this via the Steam client.
- The drop chance for sharpening stones, traps, tomahawks and totems has been increased.
- Cooldown for health and mana potions has been reduced.

[b]FIXES[/b]

- Loading times have been improved.
- The sound systems have been updated to improve stability.
- Gold coin drops, rewards and prices have been rebalanced to feel more consistent.
- Splitscreen handling in the pre-game menus has been improved.
- Gaining HP or Mana no longer counts as combat.
- Fixed a bug with loot sometimes being dropped twice.
- Fixed the bug that players would sometimes get stuck.
- Fixed a memory leak.
- When returning to Maria with the C’Thiris mask equipped as a helmet, she correctly recognizes now that the player owns the mask.
- The “Shout”-quest from Guildmaster Rudyard in Fort Finch now correctly counts the Gazers that have been affected by the shout skill. 
- Fixed events with portals to have the correct portal stone color now.
- Rearranged some items in the creative mode inventory for more consistency.
- Further improved the saving process to avoid issues in certain edge-cases.
- Improved the enemy drop rates of some event specific resources.
- Improvements to UI scaling in 4k.
- The mana orb drop rate from enemies does no longer scale up with player count in multiplayer.
- Quest and boss key items can no longer be trashed.
- Improved stability for uploading and downloading workshop items on Steam.

notes.title: Portal Knights Creator's Update Available Now
notes.content:
Portal Knights... The Creator’s Update is OUT NOW on Steam! Featuring Creative Mode, Universe Sharing, Pirate City - Landlubber's Leap and much more! Let your imagination run wild, alone or with friends and build something truly amazing! Or be inspired by other players creations on the Steam Workshop. If you've not joined us yet, now's the perfect time to!

[b]Steam Content Update 1.4.1[/b]

[b]The Big Picture[/b]
• Creative Mode – Create your own islands using unlimited resources. Share them with friends!
• Landlubber’s Leap – A pirate’s paradise with new quests, characters and more!
• Armor – Reworked, rebalanced and renamed! Plus, new epic and exotic armor!
• Spectral Knight encounters!
• Receive weekly gifts from Mailboxes!

[b]The Nitty Gritty[/b]
- The universe selection menu has been updated and it now allows the creation of “Creative” Universes. 
- Players can now create up to 5 Universes.
- Creative Universes have unique rules:
o Islands can be created from a selection of presets or copied over from other Universes.
o Islands in the Creative Universe can be freely named and re-named.
o Everything can be mined with one strike.
o All game items (blocks, props, etc.) are available in inventory and can be used without limit.
o Characters can fly – initiated by double-jumping.
o It’s always daytime.
o Plants do not grow.
o There are no enemies.
o There are no quests or events.
o There are no loot drops.
o Placement and mining distances are longer than in Adventure Mode.
o Characters can fall from an island without penalty.
o Characters cannot drown.
- Steam Workshop can be used to upload and share Universes and to subscribe to other players’ Workshop items.
- When loading a Workshop item from another player, the Universe can be visited and viewed, but you cannot mine or place items. 
- You can subscribe to as many Workshop items as you want. They don’t use up Universe slots.
- All bombs, artifacts, and potions -- except health and mana potions -- are now crafted at the new Alchemy Table.
- Players can craft three types of gift boxes containing items from a pool of resources, such as valuable crafting resources, furniture sets, vanity items, etc.

- “Palm Bay” (Island 2-01) is now called “Landlubber’s Leap” and hosts a new pirate hideout. In older universes the “Regenerate Universe” feature may be used to make this new content available. Landlubber’s Leap offers:
o Pirate NPCs with quests.
o New rewards for the player.
o New merchants selling current and new items.
o New pets.
o New hair and beard styles.
o New building blocks.

- Changes to Armor
o Some armor is now dropped from normal dungeon chests instead of being crafted. 
o Some armor has been reworked and rebalanced to better align to this new system. 
o Two additional endgame armor pieces for each class have been added to the game.
o A new upgrade station, the Altar of Enhancement, has been added to the Portal Knights Sanctuary, allowing mid-tier armor to be refined into the high-end armor. 
o Rings and Capes have been rebalanced and are now dropped as loot from epic chests and bosses.
o One new high-end Cape for each class has been added.

- Mailboxes can be crafted and placed anywhere and can also be found at large forts or villages. 
o Mailboxes will periodically have gifts for players.

- Spectral Knight Encounters
o At various points in the game players can interact with a mysterious Spectral Knight who will guide the player and give hints. In older universes the “Regenerate Universe” feature may be used to make this new content available.

[b]Other Changes[/b]
- Reduced the size of crafting stations.
- Prices for goods and quest rewards have been rebalanced to make purchases with merchants more consistent. 
- The Jade merchant and Pet merchant events are now rare events, randomly triggered.
- Tutorial NPCs on Squire's Knoll can now be relocated.
- Some tutorial texts have been reworked to better fit the player’s journey.
- The mage weapons “Dancing Swords” have been polished.
- The first-person camera block placing animation has been changed so as not to obstruct the player’s view as much.
- Block drops from enemies have been replaced with more useful items such as recipe items for potions.
- Recipes for potions have been reworked to better aid in the player’s journey.
- Mine carts and tracks can now be mined and placed.
- Dungeon chests can now be mined once they have been opened.
- The dedicated server configuration file can now be set to create a Creative Universe.
- Tree density has been lowered on vacant islands.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Inviting friends starts the intended pre-game UI flow now for the joining player. This means that joining players can select a character and then will be taken to the host’s game right afterwards.
- Several text cut-offs or incorrect line breaks have been fixed in various languages.
- The art for the world globe in the background of the title screen and the worldmap has been polished.
- Several HUD elements have been polished, both stylistically and concerning the layout.
- Improved HUD elements layout for split-screen mode, especially XB bar and oxygen bar.
- Player names now keep the red color correctly when switching islands whilst low on health.
- Water behaves better at underwater dungeon entrances now.
- The level of an island is now displayed shortly before spawning at the landing pad.
- Pets move less erratic now.
- The tutorial no longer marks the camera switch step as done when the player walks close to a wall.
- The character no longer dies twice when returning to the landing pad at the same time as they died.
- Upgrade stations now show better that they can’t be upgraded any further when they are at maximum tier.
- Player characters no longer collect loot after having been killed.
- The sit emote no longer causes issues for follow-up actions like using the teleport scroll or returning to the landing pad.
- Mage weapons with light damage cause the correct damage type now.
- Improved the layout of some islands, especially in normal size, where not enough suitable areas for enemies occurred. Due to the randomized island shapes the issue may still occur occasionally.
- The C’Thiris Cultist Mask works better with several of the hair styles now.
- The Archer Station has the correct sound and visual effect now.
- Jumping up at wall feels more consistent now.

[b]Developer Notes on the New Armor Progression[/b]
As with the changes to weapons in Update 1.3.0, we have reworked progression and loot drops for armor. Nearly all weapon stats and character level requirements for armor have been revised.

Our goal was to give players a more meaningful reward after completing a dungeon or a boss fight while at the same time refining our crafting system and giving you more choice when deciding what armor to craft and use next. 
Standard dungeon chests now contain SPECIAL pieces of armor. Finding them all will complete different sets.

The remaining armor recipes have been restructured. Whenever players gain access to new resources they will be able to craft new sets of armor and will you be able to choose between two equally powerful sets.

These changes made previous armor recipes redundant and we have removed them from the game! Any armor players crafted using those recipes will remain in their inventories, however.

We hope you like the new changes as much as we do!
 
https://youtu.be/5E4q1J7GHEc

notes.title: Portal Knights Adventurer's Update Out Now on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today’s an incredibly exciting day for the team here at 505 Games and Keen Games. We’ve just gone and launched our Portal Knights Adventurer’s Update on Steam, which is crammed full of incredibly exciting new content, most of which has been requested by our wonderful community. Want to know more? Keep reading…

[b]Features[/b]
* Island “Fort Finch” (1-03) is now a town filled with quests, new NPCs, merchants and details to discover
* A new type of merchant sells mannequins. They can be placed anywhere and equipped with the player character’s armor and weapons to show off the equipment crafted and found during the journey. The merchant can be found in “Fort Finch”.
* A new NPC type allows changing the appearance of the player character.
* Some NPCs can be picked up and be relocated to any location now.
* Several new props for home decorations have been added, including bath room furniture, cage doors, potted plants and awnings.
* A new “sit” emote has been added to the emote menu.
* Furniture can now be interacted with. The player character can sit on chairs, thrones, benches etc. and lie down on beds etc. When lying down on a bed, the time will speed up.
* A Water pump and a drain are available now.
* Pets can now be placed in pet homes. The pet homes can be purchased at Funny Jongo and once placed the pets can be allocated to the new home. The pets will freely roam about in the vicinity of the home.
* Several new weapons and weapon variants have been added.
* Enemies now take more damage when being attacked from behind.
* Crystals now have seedlings just like plants and can be grown in their correct biomes.
* Dedicated servers are available now. Players can setup their own, self-hosted servers to play asynchronous together with friends.
* Steam cloud saving is available now.
* A new type of epic chests spawns at the end of dungeons, containing special weapons which are unobtainable in any other way.
* NPCs can now be found in the island information on the map. They will list name and type as well as display whether they are relocatable or not.
* Loading screens now show gameplay tips.
* The tutorial now uses NPC’s in addition to info boards and quest texts. This should help new players getting all the info they need for a smooth start into the game. In order for the new NPCs to appear, the island needs to be regenerated.

[b]Changes[/b]
* It is easier now to escape from dangerous combat if the player chooses to do so. Enemies will give up the pursuit and return back home after some time.
* The player should be less likely to get mobbed by enemies (aggro distances have been reduced).
* The weapon progression has been re-worked. Players now have more choice of weapon type per player level and the progression is now better aligned with the player progression through the islands and the crafting materials found on the islands.
* Flying enemies are now closer to the ground, making it easier to fight them, especially for melee players.
* Combat with water enemies has been polished. Some situations have been made a bit easier, especially dealing with groups of Rumble Jelly and the Bub-Utan mages. Rumble Jelly have less health now and deal less damage. Self-heal has been nerfed for the Bub-Utans. All water enemies have been slowed down to match the walking speed of the player underwater.

* Attack and evade queuing has been improved. Additional attacks, using of consumables or evasion moves can be queued earlier now. When several different actions are queued, the evasion move will be prioritized before other actions.
* When evading, you can now roll up 1-block elevation changes
* The UI has been reworked on a technical level which improves the overall performance and stability of the game.
* Dungeon chests, bosses and enemies have been reworked to drop more interesting loot.
* Object highlighting shows more clearly now which object on the island can be interacted with. The type of interaction is now specified as well.
* The jump and fall animations of the player character have been improved.
* The island generation now makes sure that there are no holes on the tutorial island where player fall into caves.
* The building cursor turns red now when the end of the world has been reached.
* The flying enemies react better to shouts now.
* Loading times have been improved.
* Shell enemy spin attacks are now easier to evade.
* Projectile speeds for many ranged enemy attacks have been reduced.
* The character health and mana is no longer reset when switching islands or reloading the game.

* Island generation has been improved and should now cause fewer instances where buildings look out of place.
* Some sound issues have been improved.
* Water bombs work reliably now when thrown at water sources.
* The player character no longer blocks the projectiles from attacks of the Astral Totem scroll.

Our goal was to give you a more meaningful reward after completing a dungeon or a boss fight. At the same time this also clears up the crafting lists and gives you more personal choice when deciding what weapons to craft and use next. 

When finding the deepest rooms in the dungeons or after a boss fight you are now rewarded with a special weapon instead of a weapon recipe. 

The remaining weapon recipes have been restructured. Whenever you reach a new range of resources and you are able to craft a new weapon, you are no longer forced to use a specific weapon but instead you have the choice among up to three equally powerful weapon types. The three weapons you can choose from are matching the three different character talent lines available for each class.

In order to make all weapons useful and give you a real choice we had to rearrange nearly all weapon stats and all character level requirements of the weapons.

This change made the previously dropped weapon recipes redundant and we have removed them from the game! Any weapon you had crafted using those recipes will remain in your inventory, though.

2)	Extract the dedicated_server.zip file in the desired location. 
3)	Start the "pk_dedicated_server.exe" - a log file, a configuration file, and a save data folder will be created. 
4)	Close the "pk_dedicated_server.exe" in order to set up the config file. 
5)	Open the "server_config.json" file with a text editor to set up the server. ALL ENTRIES MUST BE IN ASCII OR UTF-8!

iii)	port: The port for the dedicated server. We recommend against changing this unless your firewall/router settings require it, or if you want to run several servers on the same PC (in which case each will need a separate port).
iv)	iv.  saveFolderPath: This is the location where save data will be written. This needs to be changed, if you wish to run multiple server instances on the same PC.
b)	universeSize: (Small/Normal/Large) The universe size for the dedicated server.
c)	hideConsoleWindow: (true/false) This will hide the console window. If this option is enabled, the server can only be closed by terminating it in the task manager.
d)	admins/users/guests

(1)	password: Choose passwords used to access your dedicated server by different user groups. (2)	canLogin: (true/false) Defines whether a particular user group can log in.
(3)	canKickPlayers: (true/false) Defines whether a particular user group can kick other players from the server.
(4)	canModifyWorld: (true/false) Defines whether a particular user group can mine/build blocks/props.
(5)	canInteractWithLockables: Not currently functional.

8)	If your dedicated server is behind a router (which is usually the case), you'll need to edit your router's port forwarding settings to ensure game data is sent to your host computer.         myOwnConfig.json and will write its log output to testServer.log

            "ipv4": "0.0.0.0",
            "port": 16365,

        },

        }

* Flying enemies are now closer to the ground, making it easier to fight them, especially for melee players.

* Combat with water enemies has been polished. Some situations have been made a bit easier, especially dealing with groups of Rumble Jelly and the Bub-Utan mages. Rumble Jelly have less health now and deal less damage. Self-heal has been nerfed for the Bub-Utans. All water enemies have been slowed down to match the walking speed of the player underwater.
* Enemies with ranged attacks rotate more clearly into the direction of the attack now before shooting the projectile.

* Attack and evade queuing has been improved. Additional attacks, using of consumables or evasion moves can be queued earlier now. When several different actions are queued, the evasion move will be prioritized before other actions.
* When evading, you can now roll up 1-block elevation changes
* The UI has been reworked on a technical level which improves the overall performance and stability of the game.
* Dungeon chests, bosses and enemies have been reworked to drop more interesting loot.
* Object highlighting shows more clearly now which object on the island can be interacted with. The type of interaction is now specified as well.
* The jump and fall animations of the player character have been improved.
* The island generation now makes sure that there are no holes on the tutorial island where player fall into caves.
* The building cursor turns red now when the end of the world has been reached.
* The flying enemies react better to shouts now.
* Loading times have been improved.
* Shell enemy spin attacks are now easier to evade.
* Projectile speeds for many ranged enemy attacks have been reduced.
* The character health and mana is no longer reset when switching islands or reloading the game.

tags.bug: * Island generation has been improved and should now cause fewer instances where buildings look out of place.
* Some sound issues have been improved.
* Water bombs work reliably now when thrown at water sources.
* The player character no longer blocks the projectiles from attacks of the Astral Totem scroll.

notes.title: UPDATE v 1.2 Out Now! Vacant islands, environment rework, new quests, weapons, enemies & MORE
notes.content:
This update has a focus on the story and background lore for the game. It contains new quests, NPC’s, enemies, interesting buildings and locations that will give context to the player and make the world a more interesting place.

FEATURES
- New quest chain for unlocking the worm boss portal. The quest chain will provide: 
o New tasks for the players
o New NPC’s with new dialog etc.
o New enemies (C’Thiris Cultists)
o New dungeons inspired by the C’Thiris dungeon setting
o New island environmental look with new plants, block textures etc.
o New item “Boss key” which will be required to unlock the boss portal leading to the first boss
o New rewards such as:
* Cultist vanity armor set
* New “Curse” skill
* C’Thiris basecap vanity item
* Large stone bricks block
* Yellow stone bricks block
* Squid pet
* C’thiris flag item
- New quest chain for unlocking the dragon boss portal. The quest chain will provide:
o New tasks for the players
o New NPC’s with new dialog etc.
o New enemies (Hollow Pirates, Skeleton Pirates)
o New dungeons inspired by pirate themes including a big ship
o New island environmental look inspired by Caribbean atmosphere
o New item “Boss key” which will be required to unlock the boss portal leading to the second boss
o New rewards such as:
* Pirate sabre weapon
* Pirate pistol weapon
* Pirate staff weapon
* Cannons + cannonballs. The new cannon prop can be crafted and placed on any island.
* Pirate vanity armor set
* Pirate parrot pet. It drops with a chance from a unique parrot on the 2-11 island.
* Pirate flag item
- New quest chain for unlocking the hollow king boss portal. The quest chain will provide:
o New tasks for the players
o New NPC with new dialog etc.
o New building inspired by science labs and astronomy equipment
o New item “Boss key” which will be required to unlock the boss portal leading to the third boss
o New rewards such as:
* Meteoroid trophy prop
* Goggles vanity item
* Meteoroid spell
* Laboratory deco props
- Boss portals have a new design and get unlocked
- Additional new items:
o Angel-wing cape: drops from hollow king with a low chance. When equipped the player can jump higher.
o Cat paw potion: sold by a new merchant. It reduces fall damage
o Pirate-certificate deco item
o Fake beard vanity item
o Tinfoil hat vanity item 
- New crab enemy on Caribbean and beach islands
- New NPC’s with new dialogs, quests, pre-made dungeons or buildings and special quest rewards.
- There is a new feature available in the universe selection cards, which allows users to reset the universe. The island marked as “Homeland” is excluded from the reset. This will enable the new boss key quests and other new NPCs in old universes as well
- Crystal- and asteroid themed islands have low gravity now
- Loot chests have an improved model and opening animation. They are opened via interaction now instead of destruction
- Chests can now be opened freshly every time an island is re-visited
- Most dungeon deco props can now be mined and placed by the player.
- Shelves and cupboards in buildings and dungeons are pre-filled with deco props now
- Rapid placement of blocks has been made smoother
- Jumping while opening a door no longer causes getting stuck in the door
- Miner  helmet flame is no longer obstructing sight in first person camera mode
- Various bug-fixes for events, island loading, sounds etc."
- Some islands have a new environmental appearance with a different dirt texture, new plants, lighting, sounds, props etc.: 
o “Oasis” (variation from Desert)
o “Beach” (variation of Carribean)
o “Deathtree” (variation of Toxic)
o “Hollowland” (variation of Crystal)
o “Redspace” (variation of Asteroid)
- Vacant islands are available via an in-game merchant. 
o The player buys a teleportation scroll “Deed” which permanently unlocks a completely flat island without enemies.
o The merchants sell unlimited amounts of different basic building blocks for easy construction.
- 2 new enemy invasion events for the pool of randomly occurring events. (Mummy Invasion and Stoneguardian Invasion)

CHANGES
- Rapid placement of blocks has been made smoother
- Jumping while opening a door no longer causes getting stuck in the door
- Miner helmet flame is no longer obstructing sight in first person camera mode
- Reduced save data size
- Reduced memory usage and faster loading
- Improved LOD for better performance on medium and large islands
- Health, Mana and Experience orbs only drop when needed by any of the players
- Recipes only drop, if at least one player in the group doesn’t know them already

FIXES
- Fixed incompatibility and connection loss problems with some sound devices
- Various bug-fixes for events, island loading, sounds etc.

notes.title: Portal Knights Update v 1.2 Important Information
notes.content:

notes.title: Community Questions - Update v 1.2 Vacant Islands
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Today, we want to go over a bunch of FAQs that we’ve seen across our community channels with regards to vacant islands, a major feature coming to Portal Knights as part of Update v 1.2! Many of you have been asking some excellent questions, so hopefully this blog covers most of them. If not, be sure to leave them in the comments section below and we’ll do our very best to answer them. 

OK... Let’s get started, shall we? 

[b]Q: What are vacant islands?[/b]

A: Vacant islands are basically ‘blank canvases’. We know many of you are keen to build not only a home, but towns filled with houses, gardens, lakes and more! We’ve seen some players spend literally days, if not weeks, flattening out islands and we want to save you guys the time. That’s one of the main reasons we’re bringing this exciting feature to Portal Knights! 

[b]Q: How many vacant islands will be available in Portal Knights?[/b]

A: We’ll be introducing 5 vacant islands per cluster, 15 in total. 

[b]Q: Will there be any enemies on these vacant islands?[/b]

A: Nope – Enemies will not spawn on any of these vacant islands.  

[b]Q: How do I unlock these islands?[/b]

A: Vacant islands are available via NPC merchants in-game. Players will be required to purchase a teleportation scroll, known as a “Deed” which will permanently unlock a flat, blank canvas island. 

[b]Q: What else will these NPC’s offer?[/b]

A: These NPC's will offer stacks of building blocks for a set amount of coins. The great thing is, these merchants will never run out of these resources and they can be used anywhere in Portal Knights, except the boss levels! 

[b]Q: Will I need to regenerate my universe in order to take advantage of this feature?[/b]

A: Yes – Should you wish to access the vacant islands, you will be required to regenerate your universe. HOWEVER, do not panic! :) Your home world is safe and you won't have to worry about your character progression. That is safe too! The number of islands you've unlocked will also remain the same.

[b]Q: How do I regenerate my universe?[/b]

A: Once you install the latest update, you’ll have the option on the Universe selection screen to regenerate it. 

[b]Q: I want to regenerate my universe but I’ve got items scattered across numerous islands! What should I do?[/b]

A: Before you regenerate your universe, gather any items you want to keep and take them to your home island. This will ensure that no items get wiped when you regenerate your universe. 

[b]Q: What other features will I get to see if I regenerate my universe?[/b]

A: Players will get to see the all-new boss quests, our brand-new point’s of interest which include new NPCs with new quests and also our environment changes if they decide to regenerate their universe.

[b]Q: When do I get to check out these new features?[/b]

A: Update v 1.2 is scheduled to launch on October 16th on Steam. As for console, once we’ve left the submission phase, we will be able to give you guys a launch date. We are currently targeting an October launch for both PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Stay tuned to our community channels for more info!

notes.title: Community Blog - Update v 1.2 Coming October 16th
notes.content:
Portal Knights… Update v 1.2 is just around the corner!

Our latest major update is filled with content and features we hope our community will enjoy! Get ready to acquire and build on all-new vacant islands, explore reworked islands, take part in all-new boss quests, all-new enemy invasion events, obtain new weapons, vanity items and plenty of other stuff too! Want to know more? Keep on reading…

[b]New Features and Content – Update v 1.2[/b]

* Various islands will have a new environmental appearance with a different dirt texture, new plants, lighting, sounds, props etc.
* The time between events has been reduced. Events will take place every hour, instead of every six hours.
* Vacant ‘blank canvas’ islands will be available via an in-game merchant.
* Users will have the ability to reset a universe. “Home” islands and the new vacant islands will be excluded from this reset. This will enable the new boss key quests, vacant islands and POI’s in old universes as well.

* 2 new enemy invasion events for the pool of randomly occurring events. (Mummy Invasion and Stoneguardian Invasion)
* New quest chain for unlocking the boss portals. These quest chains will provide:
* New tasks for the players, new NPC’s with new dialog, new enemies, dungeons, island environmental look with new sounds, block textures etc.
* New item “Boss key” which will be required to unlock the boss portal leading to the first boss.

* New rewards such as:
* Cultist vanity armor set
* New “curse” skill
* C’thiris basecap vanity item
* Large stone bricks block
* Yellow stone bricks block
* Squid pet
* C’thiris flag item
* Pirate sabre weapon
* Pirate pistol weapon
* Pirate staff weapon
* Cannons + cannonballs. The new cannon prop can be crafted and placed on any island.
* Pirate vanity armor set
* Pirate parrot pet.
* Pirate flag item
* Meteoroid trophy prop
* Goggles vanity item
* Meteoroid spell
* Laboratory deco props

* Boss portals will have a new design and get unlocked in a visually more impressive fashion.
* Additional new items:
* Angel-wing ring: drops from hollow king with a low chance. When equipped the player can jump higher.
* Cat paw potion: sold by a new “Points of interest” – merchant. This will reduce fall damage.
* Pirate-certificate deco item
* Fake beard vanity item
* Tinfoil hat vanity item
* New enemies including crabs on Caribbean/Beach islands and Cultists on the Oasis island
* New “Points of interest” which consists of various NPC’s with new dialogs, quests, pre-made dungeons or buildings and special quest rewards:
* Crystal- and asteroid themed islands have low gravity.
* NPC’s have more detailed facial features – freckles, scars, wrinkles etc.

But that’s not all… This update contains some great improvements…

[b]Update v 1.2 Improvements[/b]

* Loot chests have an improved model and opening animation. They are opened via interaction now instead of destruction.
* Chests can be opened freshly every time an island is re-visited.
* Most dungeon deco props can be mined and placed by the player.
* Shelves and cupboards in buildings and dungeons will be pre-filled with deco props.
* Rapid placement of blocks has been made smoother.
* Jumping while opening a door no longer causes the player to get stuck in the door.
* Miner helmet flame will no longer obstruct sight in first person camera mode.
* Various bug-fixes for events, island loading, sounds etc.
* Reduced save data size
* Reduced memory usage and faster loading
* Improved LOD for better performance on medium and large islands

[b]Community Feedback[/b]

The response so far to our announcements has been overwhelmingly positive and we cannot wait for you to check these features out for yourself! As we’ve done many times in the past, we’ll be publishing a short Community Survey soon after launch across both Steam and console for you guys to tell us what you think. Please, be as open and honest as you can be!

[b]Update v 1.2 Launch Date[/b]

So… When can you expect to check out Update v 1.2? Well, if you’re playing Portal Knights on Steam, get ready to download the update on October 16th. As for console players, we don’t have an exact launch date just yet, but once we’ve left the submission phase, we will be able to give you more info. We are however, targeting an October launch!

notes.title: Update v 1.1.3 OUT NOW - Play Together On Different Islands
notes.content:
Portal Knights! Play together on different islands NOW in Update v 1.1.3 for Steam.

We know this is a hugely popular community request and the team have been working incredibly hard to make it happen. Be sure to download now and let us know your thoughts in the comments below...

[b]1.1.3 – Content Notes[/b]

[b] Additions[/b]
• PODI is activated for the public now. The “Players on different Islands” (PODI) feature allows players in a multiplayer session or in a local split-screen session to visit islands individually. The feature can be toggled on and off in the session configuration menu. This menu can be accessed via the cog-wheel button on the character cards in the character selection menu.
◦ For the host player of a PODI session the technical requirements increase for RAM usage and upload bandwidth.
◦ There can be short lags during gameplay when co-players switch islands. This is a known issue and it will be further worked on for future builds.
◦ Some sounds like the island ambient sound behave incorrectly when playing PODI in local split screen. This is still being worked on.
◦ Some of the “Join”/”Leave” messages don’t show the correct content in all situations. This is being worked on.

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Fixed: event quest display does not show up after playing an event twice
• Fixed: Some major issues which occurred when retriggering the C’Thiris event
• Fixed: backpack freezes when opening the inventory directly after porting to a new island
• Fixed: Events won’t be triggered anymore in universes which have been played with a manipulated local time.
• Fixed: other players don’t play their beam out animation when they are traveling to a new island
• Fixed: Invisible HUD after traveling to a new island in rare situations
• Fixed: an endless loading screen which occurred in rare situations when loading an event island
• Fixed: The recipes for blue doors and windows made out of blue concrete blocks have been fixed. 
• Fixed: a rare crash that can occur for PODI when used in local split screen when one player is traveling to a new island while another player has opened his worldmap.

https://youtu.be/_vOA37hsYdg

notes.content:
· Fixed: Event quest display does not show up after playing an event twice

· Fixed: Some major issues which occurred when re-triggering the C’Thiris event

· Fixed: An endless loading screen which occurred in rare situations when loading an event island

· Fixed: The recipes for blue doors and windows made out of blue concrete blocks have been fixed.

· Fixed: A rare crash that can occur for PODI when used in local split screen when one player is traveling to a new island while another player has opened his worldmap.

· Fixed: Stuttering scenery and camera movement while playing with a controller

ICYMI - We have released a public beta update which allows our community to play Portal Knights on different islands in the same multiplayer session. 

How to switch to/from a beta branch
In order to switch between the regular and beta version of Portal Knights, do the following: 
* In Steam, right-click on “Portal Knights” in the games library. 
* Select “Properties”. 
* In the tab “Betas” of the opened window select the desired version of the game form the drop down menu and close the window. ("portal_knights_podi")
* The game should now update automatically to the desired version. If it doesn’t seem to do so, please close Steam and reopen it.

PLEASE NOTE! All of your party MUST be in the same branch in order to play together. As this is a beta branch, we highly recommend you back up your saves beforehand.

How to find the Portal Knights Save-game
The Portal Knights save-game can be found locally on your hard drive. By default the location should be: C:\Users\USERNAME\Saved Games\portal_knights
This path may vary for different languages! It is the standard path used by Windows games.

The “Players on different Islands” (PODI) feature allows players in a multiplayer session or in a local split-screen session to visit islands individually. The feature can be toggled on and off in the session configuration menu. This menu can be accessed via the cog-wheel button on the character cards in the character selection menu.

notes.title: Community Blog - Players on Different Islands, Community Feedback and Update v 1.1 News
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’re back with another Community Blog. Today, we want to discuss a number of topics, including our latest update and the introduction of one of our biggest community requests. Want to know more? Keep reading…

[b]Steam Update v 1.1[/b]
Last week, we launched Update v 1.1 on Steam. This is our first major update since leaving Early Access in May so of course, we wanted to make it a good’un!

Update v 1.1 saw the introduction of all new content, community requests and a bunch of bug fixes. New features included the option to switch between horizontal and vertical split-screen, (something our community have been requesting for a while now) all-new pets and armor, a new active portal VFX, dungeon improvements, a new island, the Kolemis Temple Trials Event and much more!

If you’ve been with us for some time now, you’ll know what to expect next… Whenever we launch an update, we want to gather as much feedback as we can from you guys. Once we launch Update v 1.1 on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, we’ll be publishing a survey for our community to fill in. We’d absolutely love to hear your thoughts! Oh… And please remember to be as open and honest as you can be with us. We want know exactly how you feel about our latest update.

[b]Console Update v 1.1[/b]
Don’t panic! It’s coming… Update v 1.1 is now in submission with Sony and Microsoft and once we have a launch date, we will let you guys know! Providing all goes well in submission, we should have that information pretty soon!

Be sure to keep an eye on our community channels for the latest info.

[b]Players on Different Islands[/b]

notes.title: Update v 1.1 Available NOW! Includes Kolemis Event, New Pets, Armor and More!
notes.content:
Portal Knights… We’re pleased to announce that Update v 1.1 is available to download right now on Steam! This is our first major update since we launched out of Early Access and it’s filled with a bunch of really cool stuff. Not only that, but the team have been hard at work tackling the bugs and issues you’ve been reporting. 

So, what can you expect in this update? 

[b]Update v 1.1 Additions[/b]
· Option to toggle the split screen direction (We’ve now included vertical split screen.)
· Host player can now kick players by right clicking their name on the map screen and choose “kick”. This kick is connected with a ban for the game session. After closing and reopening the session the kicked player can join again.
· Confirmation message for the Back to Title button
· New active portal VFX 
· New Event:
o Kolemis Temple Trials Event
· Trial island with NPCs presenting the quests of the new culture of the Pillars
· Trial of Strength (Be the last one standing!)
· Trial of Delving (Beware of the explosive barrels!)
· Trial of Agility (The floor is lava!)
o New island theme with new music, plants and scatter
o Reward island of the new island theme
· Merchant building complex with 3 merchants
· Built out of a new Blue Concrete Block
· Recipes for 9 new sets of armour
· Dungeons
o Improved randomisation of dungeon end rooms
o Several dungeon rooms have been tweaked
o Some new dungeon rooms have been added
· UI marker for NPCs, Portals and Tutorial missions
o These markers will be activated automatically after you have found the respective locations
· 3 Dog pets have been added to the inventory of Funny Jongo the Pet Merchant

[b]Update v 1.1 Fixes[/b]
· Fixed: Broken or lost Characters after Crash or sudden disconnect in multiplayer sessions
· Fixed: Massive lags and stuttering while playing multiplayer. These fixes should improve the overall network traffic. Please also keep in mind that larger island sizes will still end in longer loading times.
· Fixed: Full screen is not working correctly
· Fixed: Players can’t use the Steam UI to join sessions directly
· Fixed: Game crashes in rare cases when certain talents have been used
· Fixed: User is not able to put items into chests while their backpack is full
· Fixed: Hardmode Boss Worm deals nature damage instead of thunder damage
· Fixed: Buggy enemy behavior if an enemy moves back to their home zone after chasing the player
· Fixed: Buggy enemy behavior if an enemy can’t reach the player on higher grounds
· Fixed: Flying enemies can’t reach the player if he is hidden behind an object

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11811312/d3722a5eea2f4748559103fd211f9f5b9f2eaefb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hofix Beta Branch Update v 1.0.3 Available NOW!
notes.content:
[b] This is a beta update! Please only use this version if you were affected by one of the bugs in the list below. Before switching to this branch please backup your save files![/b] 

In order to switch to this beta version right click on Portal Knights in your Steam library and choose the beta tab. Open the dropdown list and select “portal_knights_beta”

[b]Additions[/b]
• Option to toggle the split screen direction
• Host player can kick players now by right clicking their name on the map screen and choose “kick”. This kick is connected with a ban for the gamesession. After closing and reopening the session the kicked player can join again.
• Confirmation message for the Back to Title button
•	New active portal VFX 

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Fixed: Broken or lost Characters after Crash or sudden disconnect in multiplayer sessions
• Fixed: Massive lags and stuttering while playing multiplayer. These fixes should improve the overall network traffic. Up to now we have recommended an upload speed of 2Mb/S for the hosting player. With these fixes we now lower the recommended upload speed to about 1Mb/S. However while these fixes improve the gameplay stability in multiplayer sessions for now they may cause longer loading screens on faster internet connections as we’ve had to set an upper bound for the upload speed. This will be changed in the next update. Please also keep in mind that larger island sizes will still end in longer loading times.
• Fixed: Full screen is not working correctly
• Fixed: Players can’t use the Steam UI to join sessions directly
• Fixed: Random Players can join Friends Only game sessions
• Fixed: Game crashes in rare cases when certain talents have been used
• Fixed: User is not able to put items into chests while their backpack is full

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11811312/953e61ac1dde9a8b2eb656c98f3dde0d74f7b1aa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v 1.0.2 Available NOW!
notes.content:
Portal Knights! Update v 1.0.2 is available to download now. 

We have investigated an issue with ongoing Achievements which are being reset after the 1.0.0 Update of Portal Knights. This issue came up due to changes we had to make in our code.

Sadly we can't restore the lost progress in these Achievements. We apologize for all the inconvenience this has caused for several of our Early Access players.

With the release of this patch we have stopped this so from now on no player will run into this problem again. 

The occurred problem only affected the ongoing (counting) Achievements of Portal Knights, all already fulfilled Achievements were not affected by this.

Fixes:
* Ongoing Achievements will not reset anymore.

notes.title: Update v 1.0 Available NOW!
notes.content:
Portal Knights, we've done it! We are out of Early Access and Update v 1.0 is available to download NOW!

[b]Features Added[/b]
• Local split-screen mode for 2 players
• An Outro cutscene to reveal
• A new island with:
◦ New NPCs
◦ New quests
◦ New objects
• New events
• Lore objects can be found all over the world (a new universe is required in order to see this feature)
• New resource ""resin"" now drops in different variations from trees all over the world
• In-game store to to purchase vanity DLC packages
• As a special gift to our supportive community, an Early Access bonus DLC has been added
◦ All Players who have purchased the game during it's Early Access phase will get this DLC for free, it contains:
▪ A special pet
▪ A new flag
▪ A recipe for a special throne item
▪ Recipes for special blocktypes
▪ An item to unlock a special rainbow themed island. This can be found in the in-game shop

[b]Changes[/b]
• Several graphical tweaks
• Several balancing tweaks
• Several performance tweaks
• Rebalancing of damage resistances on equipment
• Most recipe ingredients have been updated
◦ Cost of bars have been reduced
• Elemental effects for equipment have been updated
• UI in main menu has been updated to clearly split up offline play from online play, this is the first step in an ongoing process
• Improved several enemy behaviours
• Improved movement of flying enemies
• Improved ambience on event islands
• Improved performance on water islands

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Fixed: sound stops working during gameplay
• Fixed: character is being deleted due to a crash in a multiplayer session
• Fixed: event islands are not being regenerated after they are being retriggered
• Fixed: item damage type description has been corrected for several items
• Fixed: wrong amount of ingredients have been used when producing certain stacked items.

notes.title: Update v 0.8.0 is available to download NOW!
notes.content:
Portal Knights Update v 0.8.0 is OUT NOW!

[b]UPDATE - Hi everyone! We're aware of an issue with an armor set. Our team are looking into it and we hope to get a hotfix out very soon![/b]

Update v 0.8.0, introduces a bunch of improvements, features and bug fixes, including the ALL-NEW timed Spring Festival event and a HUGE rework of the talent tree! 

Our latest update also sees the introduction of level and/or class requirements, added support for Thai and Czech and much more!

[b]Portal Knights Update – v 0.8.0[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
- The Spring Event is available now with lots of new items, enemies and quests.
- A new enemy invasion event has been added.
- The whole talent tree for all three classes has been reworked. Lots of new talents have been added. Talents have visual and sound effects now. All players need to choose their talents anew due to this change.
- Warriors can craft throwing axes now.
- The Arcane Mirror has been added to the game. It allows fast travel between the home island and the last island the player was on.
- Most weapons and armour sets now have level and/or class requirements. Players who don’t fulfill these requirements will not be able to use these items effectively.
- Text-chat has a history now.
- Added support for Thai and Czech.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Damage types have been reworked. Enemies and equipment will now clearly display their damage type (if they have one). Some damage types have been renamed.
- The order in which Electro Quartz and Flame Ruby appear in the world and in crafting stations has been switched.
- The names of many items and places have been updated. Also, some items have a more detailed description now.
- The quest texts in the HUD have been reworked to reduce visual clutter.
- Area-based quests are only displayed when the player is in the corresponding area now. When there are several quests open, the nearest area determines which quest is displayed.
- Bomb recipes have been moved to the Archery crafting station. Enemies now always drop bombs rather than recipes.
- Throwing weapons are consumed now when being used.
- Backpack space has been increased to 40 slots now. Chests also have more slots now.
- A new redistributable has been added to the installation process. This has been applied in the last couple of days already.
- Loot stays in the islands longer before de-spawning.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- A crash when fighting the bosses has been fixed.
- Plants grow correctly now when the player is in the game but on a different island.
- Several crashes that occurred randomly were fixed.
- Several areas of the game have been tweaked to improve the general performance.
- The tutorial texts refer to the controller buttons correctly now.
- Pets no longer move erratically when the player is idling.
- Monkey priests don’t show the curse when outside of the Tomb of C’Thiris event island anymore.
- Achievements have been fixed.
- The loot log doesn't show incorrect items anymore.
- Continuously scrolling when opening a menu with a controller should no longer occur.

[b]Known Issues[/b]
- Joining friends through the Steam client doesn’t work. Please use the ingame joining menu.
- Joining a host who is quitting the game at the same time can cause an endless black screen for the joining player. Please re-start the game if this has happened.
- It is currently possible to join a friend who is playing with a host player who is not your own friend. The network code has been reworked as preparations for Split-Screen and “Players on different islands”. So new issues may occur due to this.
- Players leaving and joining are currently not mentioned by name in the alert popup.
- Changing the display mode from windowed to fullscreen can take two trials before it works correctly.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11811312/ac7989606672d07b1af8bbe8a9dd7573db19477d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Multiplayer Voxel World Disappearance Fix (Beta Branch)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have just released a public beta hotfix which should resolve the MP voxel world disappearance bug that some of our community have been experiencing. If you have experienced this issue, we encourage you to download this update...

How to switch to/from a beta branch 
In order to switch between the regular and beta version of Portal Knights, do the following: 
- In Steam, right-click on “Portal Knights” in the games library. 
- Select “Properties”. 
- In the tab “Betas” of the opened window select the desired version of the game form the drop down menu and close the window. ("missing_world_hotfix_beta")
- The game should now update automatically to the desired version. If it doesn’t seem to do so, please close Steam and reopen it.

PLEASE NOTE! All of your party MUST be in the same branch in order to play together. If one of your party members has had to switch to the branch due to the mentioned problems, all of you need to switch as well.

notes.title: Portal Knights Update v 0.7.2 Hotfix OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that Update v 0.7.2 is available to download NOW! This hotfix tackles a number of issues some players have been experiencing, as well as introducing a handful of changes.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Slightly tweaked the light. It should be more like the lighting in version 0.6.2 again.
- The throbbing “Ward of Protection”-sound has been replaced by a more subtle, atmospheric sound.
- The FOV slider allows for a wider range now. Personal settings might have to be re-adjusted.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed the range for the “Ward of Protection”. It was covering the whole island. Now it only covers the area shown as a blue-lined cube when placing the item.
- Added a maximum queue amount to certain recipes as a fix for the loss of ingredient materials.
- Selling stacks of items to the vendor NPC no longer can cause that the amount of sold items for the next item in the list is incorrectly displayed.
- Fixed that the Hollow King boss in normal and hard mode would sometimes be stuck in the ground.

notes.title: Portal Knights Update v 0.7.0, featuring Water and Hard Mode Bosses OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Update v 0.7.0, featuring water and hard mode bosses, is available to download NOW!

In response to community feedback, our development team have been working flat out to bring you guys lots of new content and features.

Update v 0.7.0 also sees the introduction of split stacks, the Ward of Protection, RPG enhancements, emotes, new events and much, much more!

[b]UPDATE V 0.7.0 PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]
- Water has been introduced to Portal Knights. When creating new universes and islands, many islands will have lakes. Old universes and islands will have some water thanks to certain events. 
- Water will contain new enemies and chests with specific loot. 
- New items will help the player underwater against drowning like air as loot, oxygen potions and oxygen buffs. 
- Expressive animations can be played from the new emote menu. 
- Each boss has now a hard mode counterpart that can be accessed via an instant-travel item. These items drop when defeating the regular version of each of the bosses.
- The hard mode bosses have stronger attacks and minions and should be encountered with a full party of 4 well-equipped Portal Knights. 
- To help overcome this challenge, new items will be available: rings, specific potions and new weapons. 
- The hard mode bosses have unique loot which is unavailable anywhere else in the game. 
- Stacks of items can now be split in half using the right-click context menu. 
- Shift-click allows auto-transferring items from the action bar to the backpack or chests and vice versa. 
- Controller rumble has been added. 
- The main attributes have been reworked. There are now 6 main attributes which are increased automatically for all classes on each level up with a bonus for your 2 class-specific attributes. In addition to this, the player can now freely raise any of the available 6 attributes with 3 points per level-up. All Attribute-Points have to be redistributed. 
- If the distribution didn’t go as planned, there is also a potion available for crafting to reset the attributes points. 
- The ‘Ward of Protection’ has been introduced. This item can shield a certain area of the island against enemy spawning. Already existing enemies are not killed upon placement. Also, event enemies will still spawn so that event quests can always be solved. 
- Enemies now follow the player more aggressively. They are slightly faster and can jump better over obstacles. 
- New events are available with new trophies, loot chests and challenging enemies. 
- New block types are available. 
- A new option allows changing of the field of view. 
- A new option allows various settings of shadow quality. This may help fine-tuning the performance of the game for older systems. 
- A new setting allows the player to force the camera into third person camera mode during combat when playing in first person camera mode. 
- New pets are available. 
- Enemies now drop coins. 

[b]Changes[/b] 
- Loot is no longer filled into the highlighted actionbar slot. This prevents accidental placement of freshly picked up blocks. 
- The worldmap has been improved for a smoother handling. 
- The emotes are triggered over the emote wheel. The key or controller button for the emote wheel may require the reset of the key-bindings to show up correctly. The reset button can be found in the key-bindings menu in the options. 
- The first grassland island after the homeland island (ID: 1-03) has a new graphical variant in new universes. 

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Several causes for crash bugs during game booting and island loading have been fixed. 
- Several causes for crash bugs during gameplay have been fixed. 
- Recipe lists and vendor lists can now be folded and un-folded with controllers. 
- Several minor fixes and tweaks to UI navigation with controllers. 
- Several fixes to recipe distribution at the various crafting stations. 
- Dungeons have been tweaked and improved on the various biomes. 
- The game should be displayed correctly again on systems with graphic cards with low memory. 

https://youtu.be/iGbNRSzvzHM

notes.title: COMING SOON! Portal Knights - Update v 0.7.0 - RPG Enhancements
notes.content:
Behind the scenes, our developers have been busy reworking the attributes in Portal Knights. Update v 0.7.0 sees 6 main attributes, which increase automatically for all classes as and when they level up, with a bonus for your 2 class-specific attributes. The player can also freely raise any of the available 6 attributes with 3 points per level-up.

CONSTITUTION 
Affects your hardiness. Each point in Constitution increased your pool of Health Points.

STRENGTH
Affects your striking power. Each point in Strength increases damage of your melee attacks.

AGILITY
Affects how fast you run. Each point in Agility increases your Movement Speed.

DEXTERITY
Affects your aim from afar. Each point in Dexterity increases the damage of your ranged attacks.

WISDOM
Affects your ability to cast spells. Each point in Wisdom increases your pool of Mana Points.

INTELLIGENCE
Affects your magic power. Each point in Intelligence increases the damage to your Spells.

PLEASE NOTE - You WILL NOT need to create a new character in order to take advantage of these RPG enhancements. On updating to v 0.7.0, you'll be allocated a set number of attribute points based on your current level to use however you so wish!

Update v 0.7.0 is coming very soon to Portal Knights! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DYBvJxJw46Q

notes.title: Community Blog - 14/11/16
notes.content:
Firstly… Welcome to another community blog! As you can probably imagine, there’s a lot going on behind the scenes in the world of Portal Knights, as we continue to bring suggestions to life and work on bringing a bunch of new features to the game. When we look back, it’s crazy to see how far this game has come, but we’ve still got lots in the pipeline and are we are far from done!  

[b]UPDATE V 0.6.0[/b]
Last month, we launched our latest update… Update v 0.6.0. This update introduced some huge community features to Portal Knights… NPC’s, pets, all-new events, combat improvements, the portal compass and much more! The response from the community has been incredible and we’re so pleased that you’re enjoying the update as much as we are. Looking back, Portal Knights has come a long way since launching into Early Access in February. However, be rest assured, we’re going to keep on pushing!  Soon after we launched our latest update, we asked our community to once again provide us with some feedback in the form of a short survey. This is something we’re going to continue doing, as the info we get is invaluable to the team. Many of you continue to put some time aside to give us your thoughts and for that, we want to say a massive thank you! You guys are awesome! Expect another survey on your social timeline soon after the launch of our next update… ;)  

[b]UPDATE V 0.7.0[/b]
Speaking of future updates… What’s next in the pipeline? Well... Behind the scenes, our team of developers are continuing to work flat out on the next update, which is scheduled for launch at the end of November. notes.title: Update v 0.6.2 Available to download NOW! (Contains crash fix)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're pleased to announce that Update v 0.6.2 is available to download NOW!

Update v 0.6.2 fixes a crash bug which occurred during load screens. The crash occurred for those with older hardware /  laptops and was caused by shadow rendering. Players who experienced this crash will be able to play the game with Update 0.6.2 but the shadows will not be displayed for them in-game.

We also received reports of players whose crafting stations would not work correctly after updating to 0.6.0 or 0.6.1. The easiest way to make the crafting stations work normally again is to mine them once. This will drop the crafting station and additionally some resources that may have been "stuck" in the station. Once the station has been placed again, it will work as intended from there on.

Thanks everyone for your patience! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11811312/a3a4466866e3d677b10c5d972ecf3fcf83d17c0b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Portal Knights Update v 0.6.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
V0.6.1 has been released to fix a loading issue specifically for the Chinese version of the game.

See the other changes in V0.6.0 upwards:

Additions 
- NPCs have been added to the world. They will only appear in freshly unlocked islands or new universes. 

- Many new buildings and deco props have been added together with the NPCs. 

- Added story snippets or gameplay tips to the islands via chatty “story”-NPCs. 

- There is now a trading system. Some NPCs serve as vendors with specific items in their stock that the player can buy with gold. 

- The player can sell unused items to the vendor NPCs to free up space in the backpack and to earn the gold required to buy the items offered by the various vendors. 

- Many NPCs offer quests which lead through the game and bring nice rewards. 

- The game now has pets that accompany the player on his or her journey. They are sold by a pet vendor or found with a bit of luck in cages deep down in dungeons. 

- Pets are equipped in the armor menu similar to armor or vanity items. 

- The Archer class now has a dedicated crafting station similar to the anvil and altar for Warriors and Mages. 

- A new crafting station “Drafting Table” now offers the recipes for furniture, props and the like. 

- New events with new environmental effects and added trophies. 

- Attacking and mining can now be done while moving. 

- A new tool has been implemented: the portal compass. It constantly shows north when selected in the actionbar and shows the general direction, both horizontal and vertical, of any still locked portal on the island when triggered. The recipe is automatically unlocked at level 2 of the Workbench. 

Changes 
- Seedlings have been refurbished so that it is easier to distinguish them from each other visually. 

- The item icons and 3D pictures of the character in the UI have been visually tweaked. 

- Crafting stations show their tier now better with the metal they are partially made off. 

- Loading an island with an active event now shows the remaining time at the beginning. 

Fixes 
- Several causes for crash bugs during game booting and island loading have been fixed. 

- Network code has been tweaked to cause less traffic. The improvements are ongoing, of course. 

- Save data is more secure now in case there is an unexpected PC shutdown or game crash. 

- It is no longer possible to join players who are not in friendslist over the Steam client. 

- It is no longer possible to join a game where the host is not on the friendlist over the ingame list of matches. 

- Enemies are no longer floating down walls or steep hills. 

- Several small improvements to enemy behaviour. 

- The Fruit Hat vanity item can now be crafted correctly. 

- The overall performance has been improved. This should be noticeable in large islands with many dungeons.

notes.title: COMING SOON! Portal Knights - Update v 0.6.0 - NPCs
notes.content:
In response to community feedback, we're introducing NPCs to Portal Knights in Update v 0.6.0, scheduled for release on October 6th 2016!

We're super excited to announce that we're also introducing a trading system to Portal Knights. Some NPCs are going to serve as vendors with specific items in their stock that the player can buy with gold. The player can also sell unused items to the vendor NPCs to free up space in the backpack and earn gold required to buy the items offered by the various vendors. Oh... And that's not all... As part of the update, you'll also be able to take part in all-new NPC quests! Get ready to earn those rewards. ;)

You'll also notice in the below video that a 'portal compass' is being introduced to Portal Knights. This will help those knights who want some guidance on the direction they need to take in order to find a portal... (Particularly handy when you're playing on the larger islands!)

Stay tuned for more info on Update v 0.6.0! We're super excited about this update and we hope you guys are too! :)

https://youtu.be/wUKARov-6p0

notes.title: Community Blog - August 2016
notes.content:
Can you believe it’s almost been 6 months since we launched Portal Knights into Early Access? 

No, neither can we! 

[b]COMMUNITY MATTERS[/b]
It’s crazy to think how far we’ve come since we launched on Steam back in February.  The Portal Knights you first downloaded back then is very different Portal Knights to the one you’re playing now… And we’re still pushing on! The progress we’ve made so far couldn’t have been achieved without the hard work of our development team and YOUR contribution! Our community means so much to us and your feedback is invaluable. At the end of the day we want you to love Portal Knights, which is why our doors are always open to community thoughts and suggestions. You know, we could just follow our own roadmap and dismiss any player feedback that comes our way, but in this day and age that just doesn’t work with Early Access titles.

We’re in this for the long haul and we hope you continue to stick with us. Your support really does mean everything to the team and when we do eventually leave Early Access, we’ll be proud to say we did this WITH our community! The road ahead is long and there’s still lots to do, but we’re working on it - You guys are so worth it! ;) 

[b]UPDATE V 0.5.0[/b]
Last week, we launched our latest major update, with v 0.5.0. This update saw the introduction of a bunch of community features, including larger islands, text and voice chat, vanity items and much, much more! Speaking of larger islands… On the day we made the announcement to the community, we were filled with excitement. Community Managers get ridiculously giddy over moments like this, because they know how much it’s going to mean to the fans. The response to the announcement was just fantastic… Thank you for your passion and enthusiasm, it means so, so much to us! We know these are features have been requested for a while now and our development team have been working flat out to bring them to game. The larger islands in particular have been a massive challenge, but we appreciate your patience in allowing us to work behind the scenes to get them ready. We really hope you are enjoying them as much as we are! 

Now of course, we know that when a major update comes along there’s a chance bugs might creep in. Since launching v 0.5.0, our development team have been doing everything they can to iron out these issues. We’ve since gone on to release 2 hotfixes (v 0.5.1 & v 0.5.2) which should eliminate many of the problems our community have been experiencing. We know as gamers ourselves how frustrating it is when there are issues, but you guys have been brilliant! Hopefully, we’ve got rid of out most of the issues now, but if you’re still having trouble, please let us know! You can report new issues here…

 https://fs30.formsite.com/505games/form16/index.html

[b] COMMUNITY FEEDBACK [/b]
As with all our updates, we’re trying to fill them with as much content as we can! On reflection, do you think we’re doing enough? Do you like what we do across our community channels in the run up to a launch? Or do you think we need to do more? Well, now’s your opportunity to tell us! Yesterday, we launched a Community Feedback survey based around our latest update and we’d love you guys to give us your thoughts. This is something we now want to do after every update and we’re encouraging all our players to take part. If you’re interested in giving us your feedback, click the link below… 

https://www.research.net/r/PortalKnightsUpdate 

[b]COMMUNITY SCREENSHOTS[/b]
We LOVE reading your Tweets, Facebook comments, forum discussions, YouTube comments, etc… Another thing we also LOVE to do is look through our community screenshots! Our players are so creative and we can’t wait to see what you’re going to do with the larger worlds. We’ve already seen some crazy builds, but we want to see more! If you have a construction that you’d love us to see, show us! Just head over to any of our Official social channels and send your screenshots our way. We’re super excited to see what you come up with. ;)

[b]GOING FORWARD[/b]
So, what’s next in the PK pipeline? Well, for now, we’re going to keep that answer under wraps! (We don’t want to give everything away too soon!) Let’s just say we think you’re are going to LOVE what our dev team are up to behind the scenes and over the coming weeks we’ll be giving you a sneaky peek into what to expect. Let’s just say, more community suggestions are coming to Portal Knights!

Now’s probably a good time to stop typing... Again, we’d like to thank our incredibly community for their continued support, passion, believe and enthusiasm for Portal Knights. We’re truly grateful to have you guys on board! Keep being awesome, OK?! ;)

On behalf of the whole PK team, we hope you all have a great weekend!

- PK_CM505

notes.title: Update v 0.5.2 Available NOW!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce v 0.5.2, a hotfix which should solve a number of issues you guys have been experiencing...

[b]Additions[/b]
* Turkish language has been included

[b]Changes[/b]
* Additional warning messages during loading and conversion of old save data

[b]Fixes[/b]
* Having backup folders for characters in the save data folder no longer causes character loading issues.
* Fixed a crash when trying to load corrupted save data.
* Fixed a crash when tabbing out of the game while no sound device is attached to the system.
* Fixed that microphones were not correctly muted when tabbing out of the game when voice chat was active.
